query.name: openPositionPublic
query.jpql: select e from hunttech_OpenPosition e where (e.openClose is null or e.openClose = false) and (e.signDraft is null or e.signDraft = false) and e.internalProject = false order by e.vacansyName

query.name: openPositionAll
query.jpql: select e from hunttech_OpenPosition e order by e.vacansyName

query.name: cityAll
query.jpql: select c from hunttech_City c order by c.cityRuName

query.name: positionAll
query.jpql: select p from hunttech_Position p order by p.positionRuName

query.name: projectAll
query.jpql: select p from hunttech_Project p order by p.projectName

query.name: gradeAll
query.jpql: select g from hunttech_Grade g order by g.gradeName
